# iru_device_note (List Resource)

Lists existing `iru_device_note` objects for `terraform query`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every note on one device, with config for import.
list "iru_device_note" "loaner" {
  provider         = iru
  include_resource = true
  config {
    device_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (String) Only list notes on the device with this ID. Recommended on large tenants.
